method CountLowerCaseOdd(txt: string) returns (count: int)
    requires txt != null
    ensures count >= 0
    ensures count == Sum(if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' && (ord(c) % 2) == 1) then 1 else 0 for c in txt)
